CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Real Ctrl+Zoom in the PARENA editor (matching PITVIPER's own convention) + real prnfmt-on-save (F2 runs the actual parena fmt formatter via a new runtime/prnfmt_bridge.c, solving a real Arena type collision and a real Arena symbol-name link collision); fixed a real screenshot-caught bug where the status bar rendered off-screen past ~130% zoom. v0.80.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
